===={{aniseries|JN}}====
In ''[[JN112|Helping the Hometown Hero!]]'', Samson attended a party to celebrate the return of Lillie and her family to Alola after they found [[Mohn]]. The next day, Samson watched the Battle Royal match between Ash, Kiawe, {{an|Gladion}}, and Professor Kukui.

In ''[[JN131|Paring Pokémon While Parrying!]]'', Samson was seen watching Ash's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against {{an|Leon}} at the [[Pokémon School]].
